product.title: Skyfade Family Matching Set - Dress & Shirt
product.descriptionHtml:
• Fabric: Lightweight woven fabric with a floaty, beach-ready drape; exact fiber content was not visible from the blocked vendor page.
  • Family story: A four-role family matching look for moms, dads, girls, and boys in coordinated ombre vacation colors.
  • Colorways: Choose Blue or Lavender, both fading softly into white for a breezy seaside feel.
  • Design details: Girls and moms wear the strappy ombre dress; boys and dads wear the matching short-sleeve crewneck shirt. Shorts, hats, jewelry, bags, and sandals are styling only.
  • Care: Machine wash cold on gentle, line dry, do not bleach, and use a cool iron inside-out if needed.
  • Size range: Child 2 Years through Child 9-10 Years, Mother S-3XL, and Father S-4XL.

Skyfade keeps family matching light, simple, and polished for sunny photos. The dress option has a soft strappy neckline and airy ombre skirt for moms and girls, while the shirt option gives dads and boys an easy crewneck tee in the same fade effect.

Use the Type, Size, and Color selectors to build the exact set you need for beach trips, resort dinners, family portraits, or summer weekends. The listing includes only the dress and shirt garments shown in the size chart.

Key Features:

  • Two garment choices: Dress for girls and moms, shirt for boys and dads.
  • Two colorways: Blue and Lavender share the same vendor size chart.
  • Four-role matching: Size labels are role-bearing for clearer family ordering.
  • Warm-weather styling: Lightweight ombre pieces feel relaxed for beach and vacation plans.
  • Chart-backed sizing: Every variant is backed by a row from the attached vendor size chart.

Choose the color and each family member's type and size to create a soft matching look for your next sunny memory.
